info.name: AlKhair Mobile API V1
info.description: Importable V1 mobile-development collection for every route in routes/api.php. Login stores the Sanctum bearer token automatically. Requests inherit Bearer {{token}} unless marked otherwise.

request.description: Creates a Laravel Sanctum token. User must be active and have at least one effective application permission. The response returns the same complete effective permission set used by the website.
Initial mobile payload: user, roles, permissions, mobile navigation, organization branding, localization, and feature flags.
Returns role-aware and access-scoped summary metrics for the authenticated user.
Returns the authenticated user's mobile-safe profile, role, permissions, profile IDs, and profile-photo URL.
Updates an editable username. Parent and student usernames are immutable. The application derives the account email using the same rule as the website.
Uploads a profile image using the same storage and linked student/teacher profile rules as the website.
Changes the password, keeps the current device token, and revokes tokens belonging to other devices.
Revokes every Sanctum token owned by the authenticated user, including the current token.
Revokes the bearer token used for this request.

item.name: 13 Finance Operations
item.description: Phase 9 cash-box balances, unified ledger, adjustments, transfers, exchanges, and request workflow reads. Money movements use the same FinanceService and finance_transactions ledger as the website.

request.description: Permission: finance.reports.view or finance.cash-box.view. Returns cash-box balances, currency totals, and visible pending-request counts.
Permission: finance.cash-box.view. Balances are calculated from signed finance_transactions. The response script stores source/destination box and currency IDs when available.
Permission: finance.cash-box.view. Unified source-of-truth ledger. The first returned transaction ID is stored automatically.
Permission: finance.cash-box.adjust. Requires the cash-box manual-adjustment feature to be enabled.
Permission: finance.cash-box.transfer. Creates paired out/in ledger entries.
Permission: finance.exchange.create. Omit to_amount to calculate it from configured rates; provide it for a negotiated rate.
Requires the matching pull, expense, or revenue request view permission. Return requests use revenue permissions. The first returned request ID is stored automatically.
Requires the view permission matching the request type.
